newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy PSBR may miss 96 target by 20trln lire - Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italy PSBR may miss 96 target by 20trln lire - Fazio.

text.p: Italy's 1996 public deficit may overshoot the original 113 trillion lire target by up to 20 trillion lire, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Thursday.
The government has already said its public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) for this year might climb to 123 trillion lire, but Fazio said this new forecast might be conservative.

"The overshoot with respect to the 113 trillion lire figure...could be up to one percentage point of gross domestic product," Fazio told a parliamentary committee, adding that this was equivalent to some 20 trillion lire.
Fazio said that according to latest data, it was probable that the ratio between Italy's state sector deficit and gross domestic product (GDP) would "approach seven percent" in 1996.
The government has forecast a deficit-to-GDP ratio of 6.1 percent this year, falling to 3.1 percent in 1997.
The central bank governor said that lower-than-expected economic output was one of the reasons for the overshoot in the 1996 ratio. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
